made: After the labels were frozen and the extractor had been run. Made by reading only the head and the tail of each returned text (three and five lines of an article; sixteen and nine shortened lines of structured text), not the whole of it.
status: ai_provisional: judged by the implementing AI, not by a person. A human reviewer must confirm or change each one.
rule_used: MATERIAL when the text opens with twenty or more lines of site chrome, or when chrome and other items are about a quarter or more of its lines; LOW for a few lines a reader would skip; NONE otherwise. This rule was written at judging time and is not part of the frozen protocol. It sits close to some cases: one Parliament profile has a footer of about a quarter of its lines and is rated LOW.
